entries.scope: Confidential vulnerability reporting and project-specific security policy for TuiVision
entries.rationale: Owner-approved German-first and equivalent-English reporting policy; existing response targets retained.
readerPaths: GitHub Security -> Security policy -> private advisory -> coordinated disclosure
entries.navigationImpact: GitHub discovers this policy; reporting links target this repository.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, equivalent English second; CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Bash and PowerShell documentation validation; exact reporting paragraphs, repository URLs, UTF-8, languages and headings. GitHub rendering checked at delivery; no new VoiceOver, NVDA or Braille acceptance claimed.
entries.risk: Reporting policy is no security certificate or new SLA. CodeQL configuration is separate and changes no AI Scan settings.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Reporting route, project boundaries, supported branch, response process or GitHub rendering changes.
